30798.subject: Mathematics
30798.question_text: A survey of 100 students in an institution shows that 80 students speak Hausa and 20 students speak Igbo, while only 9 students speak both language. How many students speak neither Hausa nor Igbo?
30798.explanation:
Let the number of students that speak Hausa and Igbo be represented by H and I respectively.

n(H only) = 80 - 9 = 71.

n(I only) = 20 - 9 = 11.

n(neither H nor I) = 100 - (71 + 9 + 11)

= 100 - 91 = 9 students.

30807.question_text: Make F the subject of the formula t = \(\sqrt{\frac{v}{\frac{1}{f} + \frac{1}{g}}}\)
30807.explanation:
t = \(\sqrt{\frac{v}{\frac{1}{f} + \frac{1}{g}}}\)

t2 = \(\frac{v}{\frac{1}{f} + \frac{1}{g}}\)

= \(\frac{vfg}{ftg}\)

\(\frac{1}{f} + \frac{1}{g}\) = \(\frac{v}{t^2}\)

= (g + f)t2 = vfg

gt2 = vfg - ft2

gt2 = f(vg - t2)

f = \(\frac{gt^2}{gv-t^2}\)

30820.subject: Mathematics
30820.explanation:
\(\begin{pmatrix} 2 & -3 \\ -1 & 4 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 8 \end{pmatrix}\)

\(\begin{pmatrix} 2x - 3y \\ -x + 4y \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 8 \end{pmatrix}\)

\(2x - 3y = -1 ... (i)\)

\(-x + 4y = 8 ... (ii)\)

From (ii), x = 4y - 8.

\(2(4y - 8) - 3y = -1 \implies 8y - 16 - 3y = -1\)

\(5y = -1 + 16 = 15 \implies y = 3\)

\(x = 4(3) - 8 = 12 - 8 = 4\)

\(\therefore x + y = 3 + 4 = 7\)

30822.question_text: Each of the base angles of a isosceles triangle is 58° and the verticles of the triangle lie on a circle. Determine the angle which the base of the triangle subtends at the centre of the circle.
30822.explanation:
Base angle of the triangle = 58°.

The third angle = 180° - (58° + 58°)

= 64°

Angle subtended at the centre = \(2 \times 64° = 128°\) (angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference).

30824.question_text: An arc of a circle subtends an angle 70o at the centre. If the radius of the circle is 6cm, calculate the area of the sector subtended by the given angle.(\(\pi\) = \(\frac{22}{7}\))
30824.explanation:
Area of a sector = \(\frac{\theta}{360°} \times \pi r^{2}\)

r = 6cm; \(\theta\) = 70°.

Area of the sector = \(\frac{70}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 6^{2}\)

= \(22 cm^{2}\)

30825.question_text: A cone with a sector angle of 45° is cut out of a circle of radius r cm. Find the base radius of the cone.
30825.explanation:
The formula for the base radius of a cone formed from the sector of a circle = \(\frac{r \theta}{360°}\)

= \(\frac{r \times 45°}{360°}\)

= \(\frac{r}{8} cm\)

30833.question_text: The angle between the positive horizontal axis and a given line is 135<sup>o</sup>. Find the equation of the line if it passes through the point (2,3)
30833.explanation:
m = tan 135o = -tan 45o = -1

\(\frac{y - y_1}{x - x_1}\) = m

\(\frac{y - 3}{x - 2}\) = -1

= y - 3 = -(x - 2)

= -x + 2

x + y = 5
